answer: The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The delta assignment is published and relic records each panel. Shards are assigned from the horizon graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1184 identities would post 2607 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
